    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)
    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

# PID controller for throttle control
class PIDController:
    def __init__(self, kp, ki, kd, max_throttle):
        self.kp = kp
        self.ki = ki
        self.kd = kd
        self.max_throttle = max_throttle
        self.error_prev = 0
        self.error_integral = 0

    def calculate(self, error, dt):
        self.error_integral += error * dt
        derivative = (error - self.error_prev) / dt
        self.error_prev = error
        throttle = self.kp * error + self.ki * self.error_integral + self.kd * derivative
        return max(0, min(throttle, self.max_throttle))  # Clamp throttle to [0, max_throttle]

import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# Create the vehicle system
# =============================================================================

vehicle = veh.ChVehicle("BMW_E90")
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_SMC)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.CollisionType_NONE)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)

vehicle.InitializeDriveline(driveline)

tire_front_right = veh.ChTMeasyTire("TireFR")
tire_rear_left = veh.ChTMeasyTire("TireRL")
tire_rear_right = veh.ChTMeasyTire("TireRR")

vehicle.InitializeTire(tire_rear_left, vehicle.GetChassisBody(), veh.LEFT, veh.REAR)

patch.SetContactRestitutionCoefficient(0.01)

patch.SetNormalMap(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/normal_map.jpg"), 200, 200)

terrain.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Create the visualization
# =============================================================================

# Create the Irrlicht application
vis = irr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowSize(800, 600)
vis.SetWindowTitle('BMW E90 Sedan Simulation')

vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 4, 4), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(2, 5, 2), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), 10, 2, 10, 120)

# =============================================================================
# Create the driver system
# =============================================================================

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(vis, vehicle)

# Set the initial driver inputs
driver.SetSteering(0)
driver.SetThrottle(0.3)
driver.SetBraking(0)

# =============================================================================
# Simulation loop
# =============================================================================

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Get driver inputs
    steering = driver.GetSteering()
    throttle = driver.GetThrottle()
    braking = driver.GetBraking()

    # Update the vehicle
    driver_inputs = veh.Inputs(steering, throttle, braking)
    vehicle.Advance(driver_inputs)

    # Update the terrain
    terrain.Advance(time)

    # Update the visualization
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Synchronize the Irrlicht clock with the simulation clock
    vis.Synchronize("BMW E90 Sedan Simulation", driver_inputs)

initRot2 = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization type for vehicle parts (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Collision type for chassis (PRIMITIVES, MESH, or NONE)
chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

# Type of tire model (RIGID, TMEASY)
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

# Rigid terrain
terrainHeight = 0  # terrain height

terrainWidth = 100.0  # size in Y direction

# Point on chassis tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-5.0, 0.0, 1.8)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create systems
vehicle1 = veh.BMW_E90()
vehicle1.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle1.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle1.SetChassisFixed(False)

vehicle1.Initialize()

vehicle1.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle1.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle1.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle2 = veh.BMW_E90()  # Create the second vehicle
vehicle2.SetContactMethod(contact_method)

vehicle2.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle2.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle2.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle2.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle2.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle1.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), terrainLength, terrainWidth)
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/concrete.jpg"), 200, 200)  # Changed texture

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()

vis.AddSkyBox()

driver1 = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1

driver1.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver1.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs1 = driver1.GetInputs()
    
    # Sinusoidal steering input for both vehicles
    steering_input = 0.5 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * time)
    driver_inputs2 = veh.Inputs()
    driver_inputs2.m_steering = steering_input

    driver1.Synchronize(time)

    vehicle1.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs1, terrain)
    vehicle2.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs2, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs1)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver1.Advance(step_size)
    driver2.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle1.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle2.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    step_number += 1

    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
